svg.title: Aurelia Residence floor plan
svg.desc: Original three-bedroom apartment, 18 by 12 metres, with 18 by 2.5 metre south terrace. Entry from east, bedrooms to north, living spaces south. Concept only.
svg.text: A three-bedroom terrace apartment · Dimensioned concept plan
261 m² combined concept footprint · 3.2 m proposed ceiling
Concept design · Dimensions are nominal zoning dimensions including partitions, not surveyed clearances.
